title: SPEC-TRACE trace entry (serialized form)
description: One entry of a replayable trace, in the serialized JSON form where Uint8Array values are encoded as {"$bytes": "<lowercase hex>"}. Event and intent payloads use the closed alphabet normatively owned by SPEC-EVENTS (specs/spec-events/schema/); this schema constrains only the envelope shared by every payload.

payload.description: Event or intent payload envelope. Full payload validation is SPEC-EVENTS' schema; a trace consumer must reject entries whose payload kind is outside that alphabet.

bytes.description: Serialized Uint8Array: lowercase hex, two digits per byte.
